answer: Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the quartz of a task receipt, and the trellis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
